technique_name: Téng Kōng Zhèng Tī Tuǐ (Jumping Front Straight Kick)
deduction_content: The hanging leg is bent when the toes of the kicking leg touch the forehead or above
The angle between the torso and the hanging leg is less than 135 degrees at that moment

questions.question: What is the error code for Téng Kōng Zhèng Tī Tuǐ (Jumping Front Straight Kick)?
What are the deduction points for Téng Kōng Zhèng Tī Tuǐ (Jumping Front Straight Kick)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) The hanging leg is bent when the toes of the kicking leg touch the forehead or above, 2) The angle between the torso and the hanging leg is less than 135 degrees at that moment.
